included_evaluated_in_dev_cv: FCB-10 tracking features as used by DeadBall (windowed motion computed inside the predictor)
FCB-11 DeadBall dead-ball detector: all feature groups (ball, motion, formation, restart), logistic fusion fitted on training matches, training-only threshold, min dead 2 s / live 1 s
Live-run owner: nearest-player majority vote (window 50) confined to each live run, carried within the run; X only for a live run with no vote
FCB-14 E005 short-spell carry: non-first owner spells < 1 s that disagree with the carried owner are overwritten with it
explicitly_excluded: FCB-12 Turnover confirmation state machine (E003, not adopted)
E005 X-mode variant (same spellF1 on dev, lower macroF1)
Smart Tagging inputs (no comparable dev tags to validate)
Any target-match training, pseudo-labelling or calibration (organiser clarification 2026-11-03)

open_questions: Organiser eligibility of using published DATA.md input statistics to set FCB-8 degradation rates (unresolved)

holdout_run.reports: one fitted model per input variant (clean, degraded, degraded_short_gaps, degraded_long_gaps), each trained on all 5 dev matches with primary labels and evaluated on both holdout matches; these four are prespecified robustness checks, not a choice among recipes

target_training.training_matches: the 5 dev matches in configs/split.yaml (dev list) only; the 2 holdout matches are never used for fitting, before or after opening
target_training.input_variant: degraded (FCB-8 default DegradeConfig), per-match seed match_seed(0, match_id), exactly as in dev CV
target_training.holdout_report_for_submission: degraded/primary is the headline holdout number for the submitted model; the other three are robustness checks
target_training.fallback_if_degradation_ruled_ineligible: if the organisers rule that published DATA.md statistics may not set the FCB-8 rates, train on the clean variant instead (same matches, labels, seed); its holdout report is clean/primary. This fallback is fixed now and not chosen from holdout scores.
